capabilities: Navigate wikilink suggestion popup items with Ctrl+N and Ctrl+P
Accept the selected suggestion with Enter or Ctrl+Enter
Suppress and restore the global Ctrl+N hotkey while the popup is open
Detect the popup via Obsidian's .suggestion-container DOM classes
disambiguation: Not a general vim-mode or keymapping plugin; it only changes keys while the wikilink suggestion popup is open.
extras: Desktop-only (Windows/Linux); the author has no Mac to test Cmd bindings and welcomes PRs. Relies on Obsidian's .suggestion-container DOM classes, so it may silently break on future Obsidian updates (fix is a one-line selector change). Requires Obsidian 1.4.0+. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; manual install steps are given if it is not yet in the Community Plugins list.
motivation: The author uses vim mode and found reaching for arrow keys after typing [[ tedious, and could not find a plugin that did only this without remapping the whole app.
problem: Obsidian's wikilink suggestion popup only responds to arrow keys, forcing vim-mode users to leave the home row every time they type [[ to select a link.
summary: Vim-style keybinding helper that navigates the wikilink suggestion popup with Ctrl+N and Ctrl+P and accepts items with Enter while the popup is open.
